With the swarm initiated, my next step is to establish the foundational architectural principles that will govern this migration. These principles are non-negotiable and will ensure a consistent, scalable, and maintainable solution on Google Cloud Run. I will store these principles in our shared memory so every agent in the swarm can align their work to this vision.

    "content": "Architectural Principles for AWS to GCP Cloud Run Migration:\n1. **Statelessness:** All microservices must be designed or refactored to be stateless. State must be externalized to managed services like Cloud Memorystore or Cloud SQL.\n2. **Containerization:** Every microservice must be containerized using a standardized base image. All container images will be stored and scanned in Google Artifact Registry.\n3. **Externalized Configuration:** No configuration or secrets will be baked into container images. All configuration will be injected at runtime from Google Secret Manager or environment variables set by Cloud Run.\n4. **CI/CD Automation:** A fully automated CI/CD pipeline using Cloud Build is mandatory for every service. The pipeline must include automated testing, security scanning, and deployment to Cloud Run.\n5. **Standardized Observability:** All services must emit structured logs (JSON) to standard output. They must be integrated with Cloud Monitoring for metrics and Cloud Trace for distributed tracing.",
